name: Do lever door handles require more maintenance than doorknobs?

mainEntity.name: Do lever door handles require more maintenance than doorknobs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, lever door handles do not require significantly more maintenance than doorknobs. Both types of hardware benefit from occasional cleaning to remove grime and dust. High-quality levers are designed for durability and smooth operation, similar to well-made doorknobs. However, if a lever becomes loose over time due to frequent use, it may require tightening of the set screws, a simple task. Proper installation is key to minimizing future maintenance, ensuring all components are secure and aligned from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, lever handles typically don't require more maintenance. Regular cleaning and occasional tightening of set screws are usually sufficient for both.
